title: Pulsar Payout 3.0 510 Battery
description:
Full control in a palm-sized package with the Pulsar 510 Payout™ 3.0 Full Voltage Control Battery!

Perfect for travel, this compact device can be comfortably stashed in a pocket, purse, or backpack. It features a toggle switch for easy voltage setting selection, an LED display screen showing battery life, puff counter, and current voltage, and a pre-heat function for an optimal vaping experience. With a lanyard hole for secure carrying, universal 510 threading for compatibility with most cartridges, and quick charging via USB-C port, discretion and convenience go hand in hand.

Does not include charging cable or cartridge

Product Features:
Full Voltage Control with Toggle Switch
Pre-heat function for optimal vaping experience
Lanyard hole for secure carrying
Universal 510 threading compatible with most cartridges
Quick charging via USB-C port
Assorted colors for personal style

Specs:
Capacity: 550mAh
Variable Voltage: 1.8V – 4.2V
Display: LED Screen with Puff Counter
Charge Port: USB-C (cable not included)

What’s Included:
1 x 510 Payout 3.0 Vaporizer

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste.
If you need one — we’ve got options.
